courses.School: chart-orgs, chart-years, kpi:orgs, insight:orgs, insight:peak, lookup — spelling variants (legal suffixes, punctuation) merged into one organizer
courses.Name: lookup — course title, free text; searchable in the explorer
courses.Number: lookup — catalog number; also a stable sort key in compute
courses.Date: chart-months, chart-dow, chart-years, insight:season, insight:weekday, insight:trend, kpi:span — parsed from ISO, dd/mm/yyyy and d.m.yy; each file is assigned to the July-June training year its dates fall in
courses.Instructor: chart-instr — split on commas, academic titles removed
courses.Region: chart-region, kpi:region, insight:region — fine-grained places in older files mapped to the main regions, unknown to אחר
courses.character: chart-types, chart-ptype, insight:types, insight:ptype — spelling variants of the long-walk type merged; absent from the 2021-2022 file
courses.Place: skip: only in the 2021-2022 file (site or town); Region carries the location for every year
courses.Price: chart-price, chart-bands, chart-ptype, kpi:price, insight:price, insight:ptype
courses.Price_Range: skip: band labels change every year (50 עד 100 ₪, 101-150, 100-149); the page bins Price itself in chart-bands
courses.Registration: skip: HTML link to the organizer's registration page; available in the explorer
institutions.contact: skip: contact person's name; kept to the explorer
institutions.phone: skip: HTML tel link; available in the explorer
institutions.email: skip: HTML mailto link; available in the explorer
